facts.fact: Africa Data Centres' data sheet describes its operating carrier- and cloud-neutral Nairobi NB01 facility, offering colocation (private cages, secured racks, cross connects) with 2.7 MW of client IT load; the document gives no event date, so its published date is used.

Africa Data Centres states that the three data halls of its Nairobi NB01 facility are certified as an Uptime Institute Tier III design facility (design certification); the document gives no date, so its published date is used.
